data.name: Legal.Privacy.Intro
data.value: BudgetFriend is a personal finance manager for tracking accounts, transactions, transfers and categories. This policy explains what information the app handles, why it handles it, and the choices you have. BudgetFriend does not sell your personal information and does not share it for advertising.

data.name: Legal.Privacy.Collect.Account
data.value: Account information — the email address, first name and last name you provide at registration, plus a hash of your password. We also record whether your address has been verified and when the account was created.

data.name: Legal.Privacy.Collect.Financial
data.value: Financial information — the accounts, categories, transactions and transfers you enter, together with their amounts, currencies and dates. This is the content of your workspace.

data.name: Legal.Privacy.Collect.Technical
data.value: Technical information — an opaque session identifier kept in an httpOnly cookie named “bf.session”; your theme and language preferences kept in your browser's local storage; and request logs such as IP address and timestamp kept by the web server for security and troubleshooting.

data.name: Legal.Privacy.Collect.NotCollected
data.value: We do not ask for payment card numbers, bank credentials or government identifiers, and we do not run advertising or cross-site tracking.

data.name: Legal.Privacy.Use.P1
data.value: To run your account: sign-in, email verification, password reset and session management.

data.name: Legal.Privacy.Use.P2
data.value: To store your financial records and sync them across the devices you use BudgetFriend on.

data.name: Legal.Privacy.Use.P3
data.value: To display the language and theme you have chosen.

data.name: Legal.Privacy.Use.P4
data.value: To detect and prevent abuse, such as repeated failed sign-in attempts.

data.name: Legal.Privacy.Use.P5
data.value: To diagnose faults and answer support requests.

data.name: Legal.Privacy.Sharing.P1
data.value: We do not sell your personal information.

data.name: Legal.Privacy.Sharing.P2
data.value: We share it with the hosting providers that run the application server and database, which process it only on our instructions.

data.name: Legal.Privacy.Sharing.P3
data.value: We disclose it only where the law requires it — for example in response to a valid legal process, or to protect the rights and safety of users.

data.name: Legal.Privacy.Sharing.P4
data.value: If the project is transferred to a new owner, we will tell you in advance so you can export or delete your data first.

data.name: Legal.Privacy.Storage.P1
data.value: The web version is online-first: your financial records live on the server running BudgetFriend and reach your browser over an encrypted connection.

data.name: Legal.Privacy.Storage.P2
data.value: The mobile version keeps your data in local storage on the device and synchronises it with that same server when you are online.

data.name: Legal.Privacy.Storage.P3
data.value: If you run your own copy, all of this data stays on infrastructure you control.

data.name: Legal.Privacy.Security.P1
data.value: Passwords are stored only as salted hashes. The plain password is never written to disk or to logs.

data.name: Legal.Privacy.Security.P2
data.value: Session tokens are held on the server and referenced by an httpOnly, Secure, SameSite cookie, so page scripts cannot read them.

data.name: Legal.Privacy.Security.P3
data.value: Connections to the web version are encrypted with HTTPS.

data.name: Legal.Privacy.Security.P4
data.value: No method of protection is perfect. If you think your account has been compromised, change your password from the sign-in screen and contact us.

data.name: Legal.Privacy.Retention.Title
data.value: How long we keep your information

data.name: Legal.Privacy.Retention.P1
data.value: While your account is active, we keep what is needed to run your workspace.

data.name: Legal.Privacy.Retention.P2
data.value: Verification and password-reset codes expire after 15 minutes.

data.name: Legal.Privacy.Retention.P3
data.value: When you delete your account, your financial records are removed from the application database. Copies may remain in backups until the hosting provider's normal rotation replaces them.

data.name: Legal.Privacy.Retention.P4
data.value: Request logs are kept for a limited period for security purposes.

data.name: Legal.Privacy.Rights.P1
data.value: Access and export — your data is yours, so export it from the app whenever you like.

data.name: Legal.Privacy.Rights.P2
data.value: Correction — edit accounts, transactions and categories directly, and update your name from Settings.

data.name: Legal.Privacy.Rights.P3
data.value: Deletion — delete your account to have your data removed.

data.name: Legal.Privacy.Rights.P4
data.value: Objection and withdrawal — contact us to object to processing, or to withdraw consent where processing relies on consent.

data.name: Legal.Privacy.Rights.Extra
data.value: Depending on where you live you may also have rights such as data portability, the right to restrict processing, and the right to complain to a supervisory authority. Where a self-hosted operator is the controller of your data, send those requests to them.

data.name: Legal.Privacy.Children.Body
data.value: BudgetFriend is not directed at children under 13, or under the minimum age of consent in your country, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from them.

data.name: Legal.Privacy.Changes.Body
data.value: We may update this policy as the app changes. The date at the top always reflects the current version, and for material changes we will announce them in the app before they take effect.

data.name: Legal.Privacy.Contact
data.value: Questions about this policy? Write to us at support@budgetfriend.zaidalkallas.me.
